Register Today. Charities announced!

We’re delighted to announce the charities selected to pitch at our Autumn Connector, following nominations from TFN members and consideration by a panel of members.

At the event, we will hear pitches from:

Chamos – In Aid of the Children of Venezuela, which helps children affected by recent earthquakes to continue their education.

Lawyers Who Care, which supports care-experienced young people to build successful careers in the legal profession.

Youth Environmental Service (YES), which creates employment opportunities for young people from diverse backgrounds in the environmental sector.

Please see below more details on the selected charities.
